for dietary fiber and cancer: “Low-fat diets rich in fiber- 
containing grain products, fruits, and vegetables may reduce 
the risk of some types of cancer, a disease associated with many 
factors.” Box 11-5 lists health claims that manufacturers can 
use to describe food-disease relationships. In 2013 the FDA 
added a regulation that defines “gluten-free,” to clarify its 
voluntary use in food labeling and to help consumers with 
celiac disease to avoid foods containing gluten (see Chapters 26 
and 28).
